## Cross-section audit

### Terminology and state preservation

`NEEDS_REVISION`, `BLOCKED / UNDECIDED`, `NOT_FROZEN`, `CRITICAL`, `proposed minimum`,
`owner decision`, `acceptance evidence`, and `deployment/runtime evidence` are used consistently.
The packet correctly distinguishes the GR-01 final document-review `WARN` from the H1 writer/gate
position `NEEDS_REVISION`, and the GR-03 document-quality `ALL PASS` from the still-unfrozen H3-H5
decisions.

### Gate order and dependencies

The packet preserves the two-stage H2 topology: the owner first records the RBAC choice needed for
the complete ADR-068 result, then H1 can close only after MSP promotion/index proof, and H2 can
close only after the accepted rule is explicit and the real fail-closed suite is independently
accepted. H3 then supplies the canonical opaque binding boundary; H4 owns tenant data/audit/CAS
and lifecycle against that reference; H5 depends on H2/H4 for report authorization and persistence
policy. H6 and all implementation remain downstream. H8-H12 runtime, delivery, action, and release
evidence are not pulled forward.

### Evidence coverage and decision ownership

Each gate has current evidence, missing evidence, owner questions, required acceptance artifacts,
and a fail-closed outcome. The packet names the human owner/MSP/gate-owner boundary rather than
self-approving a recommendation. Option A remains a recommendation; the DEV inclusion, reviewer
scope, read-audit policy, grant lifecycle, Core RBAC/Team policy, binding proof, retention,
masking, freshness, and cap semantics all remain explicit owner decisions.

### Source/current/proposed separation and authorization safety

Indexed authority, current branch behaviour, proposed minimum decisions, acceptance evidence, and
deployment/runtime proof are separated. Current tests and validation results are explicitly
inherited and bounded; the non-green full-suite baseline is visible; no build or production smoke
is implied. The packet invents no model/table/column/flag name, uniqueness domain, policy window,
freshness value, KPI extension, masking exception, recipient rule, or alert-cap value. Existing
numbers such as the CR-010 36-hour rule, route count, and reported test counts remain attributed
current-source facts rather than new policy.

### Cross-references and document control

All explicitly named repository source paths and every GR handoff resolve. Section references and
evidence IDs resolve within the packet or the implementation-plan evidence catalogue. HTML code and
strong tags are balanced. Frontmatter and footer both identify version `0.1.0b`, status `candidate`,
date, author, and evidence-base commit `3d8c64e`; the packet hash stayed unchanged throughout this
review.

## Exact fix findings

None. No Critical, Major, Minor, Nit, or soft-gate correction is required for the reviewed packet.
The open H1/H2 warnings, H3-H5 owner decisions, CRIT-001..003, non-green inherited full-suite
baseline, and absent H8-H12 evidence are deliberately preserved project blockers, not defects in
this synthesis.
